_comment: GlobalCart fraud detection rulebook (mock). Read-only fixture for Quest #04 Part B. Do not edit.

scoring._note: Each triggered rule contributes its weight. The sum is capped at 100 and mapped to a risk band.

risk_bands.action_hint: proceed with the normal refund flow
proceed, but attach the risk report to the decision
block the automatic refund and escalate to the security channel

rules.name: repeat_refund_claims
rules.description: Three or more refund claims opened by the same customer within the trailing 60 days.

rules.name: last_minute_address_change
rules.description: The shipping address was changed within 7 days before the delivery date. A classic re-route pattern.

rules.name: new_account_high_value
rules.description: Account is less than 30 days old and the order total is 500 USD or more.

rules.name: prior_fraud_flag
rules.description: The customer record already carries at least one fraud flag from a previous investigation.

rules.name: high_initial_fraud_score
rules.description: The risk score inherited from the upstream scoring service is 60 or above.

rules.name: high_value_claim
rules.description: The order total is at or above 500 USD, ten times the standard automatic refund cap.

rules.name: item_never_arrived_claim
rules.description: The claim is that an item is missing from a delivered order. Unverifiable from the courier record and therefore a common abuse vector.

rules.name: refund_amount_velocity
rules.description: The customer has been refunded 250 USD or more in total within the trailing 60 days.
